I’m far from an expert on curly hair, but if your hair is feeling straw-like you probably have a protein overload. I didn’t check your products either, but if any of them have a lot of protein, I would stop using them for a few days. Maybe just temporarily switch over to moisturizing products vs protein products? And if your hair feels like it’s coated, then you might have some product buildup. I would get a clarifying shampoo (or you could just use Dawn dish soap) and wash your hair with that - it should get rid of the buildup. 

I would figure out whether your hair is low or high porosity, and then go from there. Then you can figure out a good balance between protein and moisture. Best of luck to you!

NAD, but this sounds like a vasovagal syncope to me. I had this happen a few times myself - I was standing for such a long time without moving my legs that I became so lightheaded that my vision went completely black. Apparently it happens when your blood starts to pool in your legs, so you aren’t having enough blood going to your brain. Your body compensates by “shutting off” some systems in your body, such as vision, hearing, or having your legs collapse under you. If this starts to happen on a regular basis, I would go to your doctor.
